name: Hardstyle 150
brief: Hardstyle and euphoric hardstyle from the crate, mixed by Claude DJ. Hosts talk only on intros/outros: who the artist is, the story of the track, festival moments, a fact. Short, hyped, never over a drop.

music.brief: hardstyle / euphoric hardstyle, 148-155 BPM, anthems at the peak
music.talk: a 10-25 s break every 2-3 tracks, over the incoming intro, ducked

clock: talk break: back-announce + a fact about the next artist
